payload.text: I disagree with command plumb approve <IDs> . The user does not keep track of ID. And cards should be resolved only through question clarifications, not by reading what the AI writes. Only the AI considers whether its context make sense, converges or not. This relates to the questions I just answered too. Make sure that plumb stays "fit" in terms of the content of the repo. We might have a lot of garbage now that rationalisation is on going, what do you reckon? Can you review my answers and give your analysis on how the workflow is streamlined? Maybe update the intent/specs in that regard?
